response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform development; their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with only brief C++ exposure in early roles, and no evidence of leading cloud compute platforms or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers as required.
strengths: Strong full-stack experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems
Proven track record of open-source contributions and technical mentoring
Extensive experience with distributed systems, CI/CD, and DevOps tooling
concerns: Only minimal C++ experience, far below the 8-year minimum requirement
No demonstrated experience with cloud compute platforms or large-scale infrastructure design
Lacks documented technical leadership in cloud or DevOps engineering teams
